items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We played once at Carnegie Hall with Tony Williams, with Lifetime, Archie Shepp, Weather Report, my group.

ctx.x: Yeah. Some of it was headed that direction. That’s when I started getting the young audiences. Then I started – I had – I can’t even think of the guy’s name. He’s in California now. I had some good musicians. Some of them worked with Miles. I had some good cats there. I had some good times, too. When I had the name – we played once at Carnegie Hall with Tony Williams, with Lifetime, Archie Shepp, Weather Report, my group. We burnin’. We had a standing ovation. We went to Europe, Japan. I had a nice little run…
